note: Emission looks per state. The USDZ ships Idle. The game sets these on the materials of EmitterCore and EmitterRing_Outer/Inner at runtime (RealityKit PhysicallyBasedMaterial emissiveColor + emissiveIntensity). usdEmissiveColor = emission colour x strength, which is what Blender writes into UsdPreviewSurface.emissiveColor. Hit and Destroyed are suggestions built from the same materials; no gameplay is attached.

parts.ringsSpinAxis: local +Z of EmitterRings (the firing axis, toward the camera)

Charging.suggestion: ramp core strength Idle -> Charging over the warning time; rings spin up

Firing.suggestion: beam is separate (not in this asset); core scale 1.0 -> 1.15 while firing

Hit.suggestion: flash M_Ivory emission white for ~0.1 s, small root shake; materials unchanged

Destroyed.suggestion: core and rings emission to 0; detach Armor_*, LeftAntenna/RightAntenna and Left/RightSideModule entities with their pivots; MainBody stays as the core. Detached armour is single-sided: render its material double-sided (faceCulling .none) while it tumbles.
